text: Program Description Educational Objectives The program for Industrial Engineering aims at training students to become experts in operational management and system analysis, who will be able to plan, design, evaluate, and optimize the production system with creative and critical thinking in the areas of manufacturing, business, and service. Students majoring in Industrial Engineering are required to master basic theories of industrial engineering, receive trainings on basic knowledge and methods of industrial engineering, and acquire basic abilities for development and design of practical management system. The graduates are required to master the knowledge or abilities as follows: 1. Basic theories and knowledge of industrial engineering; 2. Analytical methods and technology of systematic management; 3. Knowledge of mechanical engineering and Strong ability of computer and foreign language application; 4. Methods, specifications and standards which are related to economic construction and enterprise management； 5. The leading edge and development trend of modern industrial engineering; 6. Basic methods of literature retrieval and information inquiry, as well as the abilities of scientific research and practical working.
